name: Project Management Plan
excerpt: Project Management Plan integrates all project documents for execution.
notes: The Project Management Plan is a document used to integrate all other project documents and guide execution, monitoring, and control. It facilitates communication among stakeholders, serves as a baseline for measurement and control, and acts as a starting point for future comparison. The plan should be dynamic and flexible to adapt to changes.
